meta.title: AI Hybrid Video Production — Pixtoon
meta.description: Commercial video production in as little as 3 days, from €1,000 for 20 sec. AI, animation and filmmaking in one pipeline, directed by humans. Pixtoon studio, Chișinău.

hero.lead: AI + animation + filmmaking, directed by humans.
hero.highlight: Commercial video production in as little as 3 days. Starting from €1,000 for 20 sec.

title.a: AI is part of the pipeline.

process.lead: We combine traditional creative production with the latest AI tools to produce high-quality commercial content faster and more efficiently.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We learn about the brand, product, objective and audience.

steps.title: Concept
steps.text: Pixtoon develops the creative idea, script and visual direction.

steps.title: AI production
steps.text: AI is used where it makes production faster or opens creative possibilities: characters, environments, product visuals, shots and visual development.

steps.title: Animation & post
steps.text: Our team handles animation, compositing, editing, voice, music, sound design and final polish.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Final commercial video delivered for social media, digital ads, YouTube, TV and DOOH.

items.title: Production can be completed dramatically faster than traditional production.
Starting price for a 20 sec hybrid video.
Many concepts can be produced without locations, actors, physical sets or large crews.
Create characters, environments and situations that would be expensive or impossible to shoot traditionally.

hybridCard.text: We combine whatever the idea actually needs.

included.lead: From first brief to final master — no middlemen, no handoffs, no surprises.

monthly.lead: Turn one campaign, mascot, product or brand universe into a continuous stream of video content. Instead of starting from zero each time, we build a visual system for the brand and continue producing new stories, situations and formats every month.

packages.label: Monthly package 01
packages.title: 2 AI / 3D hybrid videos per month
packages.idealFor: Ideal for brand mascots, product content, character-based content, social media campaigns and recurring branded stories.

packages.label: Monthly package 02
packages.title: 4 hybrid / filmed videos per month
packages.idealFor: Ideal for regular social content, products & services, campaigns using real people, Reels / TikTok / Shorts, filming + AI + motion graphics.

custom.label: Custom monthly production
custom.title: For brands that need larger content volume or a custom production system.

closing.text: We create the visual system once and use it to produce new branded content month after month. The advantage is continuity, not simply more videos for less money.
closing.text2: Once Pixtoon develops the brand's visual world, characters, visual style, tone and recurring formats, new content can be produced faster while maintaining a consistent brand universe.

pricing.note: Final price and production time depend on concept complexity, duration and required techniques.

finalCta.lead: Tell us what you want to promote. We'll recommend the smartest way to produce it.

caseStudy.solutionLead: How we combined filming, AI and post-production.
